user_story: As a user, I want to navigate between the iframe example links on the Frames page so that I can access different content related to frames. Acceptance Criteria: When I visit the page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/frames', I should see the links 'Nested Frames' and 'iFrame'. Clicking on 'Nested Frames' should change the URL to 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/nested_frames', while clicking on 'iFrame' should change the URL to 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/iframe'. Additionally, the link to 'Elemental Selenium' should be visible in the footer section.
